title: Emit complete SRD provenance page ranges for multi-page records
description:
The SRD 5.1 pack often emits only the starting page in `record.provenance.locator` even when source coverage/ledger evidence shows the record spans additional pages. This weakens primary-DM discoverability and source traceability: a model following the record's locator may not find all source text.

Confirmed in the 2026-06-30 audit bundle `/home/jhbongaarts/src/dnd5e-srd-audit-bundle-0630-1.zip` by comparing `pack/records.json` locators to pages implied by `reports/source-region-ledger.json` and `reports/source-coverage.json`.

Current lower-bound result: at least 283 records have covered pages missing from their locator. This is a lower bound because the current source ledger omits some continuation pages and sidebars.

Examples:
- `action:ready` has locator `p. 93`, but coverage spans p93-p94.
- `background:acolyte` has locator `p. 60`, but coverage spans p60-p61.
- `condition:paralyzed` has locator `p. 358`, but coverage spans p358-p359.
- `creature:adult-brass-dragon` has locator `p. 291`, but coverage spans p291-p292.
- `rule:wizard-your-spellbook` has locator `p. 54`, while source text continues on p55; this continuation is also affected by the source-ledger coverage bug.

Acceptance criteria:
- Multi-page records emit complete page ranges or page lists in provenance, not only the first page.
- Add a regression check that compares provenance locators to coverage/ledger-derived pages after the source coverage evidence is fixed.
- Document the intended locator format for single-page, contiguous multi-page, and non-contiguous source-backed records.
close_reason: Added enrichProvenanceFromRegionLedger: unions source-region-ledger page evidence into single-page locators (excluding cross-document content-search matches and heading-collision outliers beyond a small continuation gap), giving 345 records complete multi-page provenance. Documented the locator format. Filed eshyra-erf5.6 for an unrelated pre-existing ledger tie-break bug discovered along the way.
